svg.title: OPBD-1: capture and processing wanted the spool on different schedules
svg.desc: Two lanes over the same interval. Capture holds shared access to the spool and keeps writing. Processing starts, needs exclusive access, and exits with its lock-contention code without writing anything authoritative. After capture finishes, processing runs again and completes safely; exact reruns are idempotent. Nothing was corrupted.
svg.text: OPBD-1, one paired interval, schematic. Order of events is from the run record; widths are not to time scale.
holds shared spool access · captures keep landing COMPLETE

g.text: What it showed: processing has a different resource boundary (exclusive spool) and a different
lifecycle (it can wait and catch up). That is the evidence the OPBD-4 decision used to extract it.

svg.text: Single accepted lab baseline, not a fleet rate. Nothing was corrupted.
